subject: Vendor portal enrollment + PO matching rules / payment timing
messages:
From: Elena Ortiz <accounts.payable@ingeniouslabs.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: accounts.payable@ingeniouslabs.com
Date: Sun, 26 Apr 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: New vendor registration - onboarding + PO matching requirements

Hi Rachel,

Thanks for agreeing to get Redwood set up in Ingenious Labs' AP portal. To keep the first payments smooth, we need to capture a few items and confirm our PO-invoice matching expectations. Can you confirm the following?

- Company legal name as it should appear in our portal (exact match to W9/W8).
- Remittance / payee identifier (for our system we use a 6-8 char Vendor Code) — prefer to send test PO once assigned.
- Bank routing: we accept ACH (US), IBAN (EU), and SWIFT for international wires. Please provide a bank-letter PDF with account name, IBAN / routing, and intermediary bank if applicable.
- Tax treatment: are you US domestic (W-9) or a non-US entity that needs reverse-charge handling? If non-US, please provide VAT registration or local tax certificate.

Operational rules we enforce:
- Invoices must include our PO number in a top-level field and in the invoice line-item descriptions so our matching engine ties line items correctly. Our PO format will look like IL-<6 digits>.
- We allow a 14-day invoice matching grace window for newly onboarded vendors (first 2 invoices) to prevent holds; after that the standard 3-way match rules apply.
- Payment terms default to Net45 unless Contractual terms specify otherwise. Early payment programs may be available once vendor is verified.

To proceed, please: (1) register via our vendor portal (link below), (2) reply with the documents above, and (3) let us know preferred payment terms if different from Net45. I can provision a temporary vendor code for testing after registration.

Registration link: https://vendor.ingeniouslabs.com/register/REDWOOD-2387

If it helps, we can schedule a 20-minute walkthrough with our AP specialist next week.

Best,
Elena Ortiz
Senior AP Analyst
Ingenious Labs
attachments: vendor-portal-instructions.pdf
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Ortiz <accounts.payable@ingeniouslabs.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 27 Apr 2026 08:46:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: New vendor registration - onboarding + PO matching requirements

Hi Elena — thanks, received and noted. Quick answers inline below and attaching the W-9 and bank letter for your portal upload.

- Legal name: Redwood Inference, Inc. (please use exactly "Redwood Inference, Inc." in your portal).
- Remittance / vendor code: we don't have a fixed code on our side — happy to accept the temporary IL vendor code you provision and will reference it on the invoice.
- Bank routing: attached bank_letter_redwood_2026-04.pdf (includes ACH & SWIFT details).
- Tax: we are a US corp — W-9 attached.

Notes on invoices/payments:
- We'll ensure the IL-prefix PO number is included as a separate field and repeated in line descriptions per your matching guidance.
- Net45 is fine for this relationship. We are interested in the early-pay option; please send program details and fee schedule if available.

Next steps we've taken:
1) I've uploaded the W-9 to our shared onboarding doc and attached the bank letter here for your portal.
2) Marcus (CC) will provision a sanitized test invoice (IL-000412) once you confirm the temporary vendor code so you can verify matching.
3) Kimberly (CC) will confirm the final remit address and contacts for payment inquiries.

Do you need any additional corporate attestations (e.g., corporate registry extract)? If so, we can provide.

Thanks — looking forward to the walkthrough if you think it will speed things up.

Best regards,
Rachel Kim
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
attachments: Redwood_W9.pdf, bank_letter_redwood_2026-04.pdf
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Apr 2026 10:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: New vendor registration - onboarding + PO matching requirements

Thanks Rachel / Elena (looping in Marcus for the test invoice). A couple of operational clarifications from Finance:

- Bank verification: before any wire/ACH we require the bank-letter + micro-deposit verification for ACH. For international wire, we require beneficiary name match and SWIFT verification.
- Invoice fields: please ensure the invoice JSON/pdf contains these explicit metadata fields: vendor_name, vendor_tax_id, vendor_code (your portal code), customer_po, invoice_date, invoice_total, line_item_po_reference. If the portal accepts structured fields we will map them directly; otherwise include a cover page with a clearly labeled PO field.
- Remittance address: Redwood Inference, Inc.
  1202 Market St, Suite 400
  San Francisco, CA 94103

- Grace window / holds: Finance will honor the 14-day onboarding grace for the first two invoices. After that invoices missing PO will be held and routed to AP ops for resolution. Please advise Elena if any invoices are going to be submitted without a PO (one-off engineering credits, etc.) and we'll create exceptions on a case-by-case basis.

Marcus — can you prepare the test invoice with PO IL-000412 and include vendor_code placeholder so their matching engine can process it? I'll coordinate micro-deposit next once we have the temporary code.

-kimberly
Kimberly Park
Director, Accounts Payable
Redwood Inference
From: Elena Ortiz <accounts.payable@ingeniouslabs.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: accounts.payable@ingeniouslabs.com
Date: Thu, 29 Apr 2026 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: New vendor registration - onboarding + PO matching requirements

Hi Rachel / Kimberly / Marcus —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and the attachments. I've provisioned a temporary vendor code IL-RW123 in our portal and uploaded the documents you sent. We created the vendor record under "Redwood Inference, Inc." and flagged you for the 14-day onboarding grace.

Two quick updates:
- Test PO IL-000412 is live in our sandbox; please submit the test invoice referencing IL-RW123 so our matching job can complete.
- Early-pay program details: see the DocuSign enrollment link below if you want opt-in; it is an invoice-level factor with a 1.25% discount for Net15 payout.

DocuSign & enrollment: https://app.ingeniouslabs.com/earlypay/enroll/REDWOOD

Once we receive the test invoice and confirm the micro-deposit, I'll mark the account as verified and route the first live invoice through payments. If any hiccups, I'll escalate to our AP ops lead and include you.

Best,
Elena Ortiz
Senior AP Analyst, Ingenious Labs
